theorems.name: Submission.p05_ums_inner_inverse_of_minors_a5b449214a
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p d : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin d ↪ Fin p) (_hunit : IsUnit (Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols))) (_hnext : ∀ (rows' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin n) (cols' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin p), Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows' cols') = 0), ∃ Q : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin n) R, P * Q * P = P
theorems.natural_summary: Composes the accepted minor-reconstruction theorem with the accepted construction of an inner inverse from that reconstruction.
